title: Build your 3-watch collection: one dress, one sports, one chronograph/GMT
why: Tiered BUILD YOUR COLLECTION (see FORMATS.md). Viewer picks one per tier; never pre-pick. Every price and photo is already in watch-wire-engine/library (photo.js find "<ref>": price with source and date, read 20 Nov 2026). Tier 2 Sports, up to $10,500: Breitling Superocean 42 A17366D81C1A1 $4,950; Omega Seamaster Diver 300M 210.30.42.20.01.001 $6,700; Rolex Submariner 124060 $10,050. Tier 3 Chronograph or GMT, up to $12,000: Omega Speedmaster Moonwatch 310.30.42.50.01.002 $9,000; Breitling Navitimer B01 41 AB0139A71G1A1 $10,700; Rolex GMT-Master II 126710BLNR $11,800.
